title: VTC: recording/livestream identical values
description: Template: jmap_server::check_read_only_patch / strip_read_only_patch (crate-jmap-server/src/helpers.rs) as used in mail (8a4d5b74 rewritten; git log --grep 'bd: JMAP-t8ej.25.1'). RFC 8620 §5.3: server-set properties MAY be in the patch if identical to the current value, else invalidProperties. Mark's decisions (on JMAP-t8ej.27 notes): {} and identical-only patches are a no-op success (updated {id:null}, no write, state unchanged); unknown-only patches and empty structural arrays stay errors. ORDER (lesson from t8ej.26): existence -> permission/closed-state/forbidden gates -> read-only check -> no-op exit. One test per handler, oracle the RFC/spec text. jmap-vtc-server media.rs VTCRecording update (~946) and VTCLivestream update accept only 'state'; accept identical server-set values (startedAt, callId, ...). Check what {} does on those paths and make it a no-op. Also strengthen participant no-op tests in crate-jmap-vtc-server/tests/server_set_patch.rs (participant_identical_server_set_values_are_a_noop, participant_empty_patch_is_a_noop) to re-/get and compare with before, like the call tests (adding assertions, not weakening).
